specialist.name: Weather Man
specialist.resume: Hi I'm Weather Man! I have a whole bunch of weather sensors, so I can tell you what the weather is anywhere in the world.

script.description: Fetches the current weather conditions for a given location.

arguments.argument: The city or place to look up. Accepts multi-word names (e.g., "New York" or "Boston MA").

script.output: JSON object with fields: location, temp_c, temp_f, feels_like_c, feels_like_f, humidity_pct, wind_speed_kmph, wind_direction, visibility_km, description, uv_index.

script.description: Fetches a 3-day weather forecast for a given location, including hourly breakdowns.

arguments.argument: The city or place to look up. Accepts multi-word names (e.g., "Los Angeles" or "London UK").

script.output: JSON object with fields: location, forecast_days[]. Each day includes: date, max_temp_c, max_temp_f, min_temp_c, min_temp_f, avg_humidity_pct, sunrise, sunset, and hourly[] with time, temp_c, temp_f, feels_like_c, feels_like_f, chance_of_rain_pct, chance_of_snow_pct, wind_speed_kmph, description.
